step: An Inventory logs button in place of each row's History: every product's movements, newest first (2026-11-03)

plants.name: 1 the log oldest first
plants.old:
where: { locationId },
      orderBy: [{ createdAtDate: 'desc' }, { id: 'desc' }],
      take: limit + 1,
plants.new:
where: { locationId },
      orderBy: [{ createdAtDate: 'asc' }, { id: 'asc' }],
      take: limit + 1,

plants.name: 2 the log never saying there are older lines
3 a receipt's line without the receipt's code
4 the log shown without the right to see the inventory
plants.old:
const { parts, location } = await this.allow(authorization, [Accesses.InventoryView]);
    const { lines, more } = await parts.ledger.log(location.id, InventoryLogsShown);
plants.new:
const { parts, location } = await this.allow(authorization, []);
    const { lines, more } = await parts.ledger.log(location.id, InventoryLogsShown);
